whatsOn.heading: Sound, Shows & Good Times
whatsOn.intro: Live music, resident DJs, dance shows, and parties that don't quit — the night here doesn't slow down after dark.
whatsOn.sportsBlurbBody: Football, Champions League, UFC, Formula 1, NBA — we screen the games that matter, every time they're on. Come by, or reserve a table so you don't miss kickoff.
whatsOn.stadiumAlt: Sports fans watching a match on the big screen at Pépère Marrakech

foodAndDrinks.heading: Tagines, Grills & Everything Between
foodAndDrinks.intro: A handful of recipes the house is built on, and a full menu of tagines, grills, seafood, and more waiting behind them.

bar.heading: Wine, Beer & Everything Between
bar.intro: From cold pressions to reserve wines, classic cocktails to top-shelf spirits — our bar keeps every table stocked, whatever the order.

experience.heading: Bold, Fresh, and Friendly
experience.paragraph1: Every dish begins the same way — fresh ingredients, real technique, no shortcuts, whether it's off the grill, out of the tagine, or straight from the pan. It's slower. It's worth it.
experience.paragraph2: We build each plate around what's fresh that morning, not what's convenient.
experience.paragraph3: And when you sit down — whether it's a quiet dinner or the whole table watching the match — you're looked after the same way.

whatsappCta.intro: Fastest way to book a table, ask about tonight's game, or plan a private event.

menu.heading: The Menu
menu.intro: Tagines simmered slow, fish and grills straight off the charcoal, tapas to share, and a full bar to match — everything Pépère serves, in one place.

header.heading: Less Restaurant, More Gathering
header.intro: Even the name says it — something familiar, relaxed, easygoing. Pépère Marrakech opened right as the World Cup kicked off, but it was never meant to be just a place to watch the match. It's the kitchen that runs from lunch to 2AM, the table that always has room for one more, and a room built to feel like a big night among friends, not a sit-down restaurant.

narrative.heading: Long Lunches, Longer Nights
narrative.paragraph1: Pépère Marrakech opened its doors right as the World Cup kicked off, built for the kind of evening that starts with a late lunch and ends well after the final whistle.
narrative.paragraph2: The kitchen runs non-stop from midday to 2AM, with new suggestions added daily based on what's fresh that morning — no clock-watching before last call, whether you're in for lunch, dinner, or a snack during extra time.
narrative.paragraph3: Keep the prices fair, add live music and performances every single day, and let the room feel like one big table of friends — football fans and neighborhood regulars alike.
